nodes.title: Input_Positive
widgets_values: The woman from <Picture 1> walks towards the camera until her face fills the frame. Then she says, "Cubric Vision rocks." She is outdoors on a rainy city street at night, neon signs reflecting on the wet pavement. Sound of rain, distant traffic, and her bare feet on wet stone.
